senses.sense_definition: The practice of a woman having more than one husband at the same time.

examples.text: In some cultures, <w>polyandry</w> was historically practiced as a way to keep family land intact.
Anthropologists have studied the social structure of societies that permit <w>polyandry</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A mating system in which one female mates with multiple males.

examples.text: Biologists observe <w>polyandry</w> in several species of birds where females compete for access to males.
The study suggests that <w>polyandry</w> increases the genetic diversity of the offspring in this insect population.

senses.sense_definition: The botanical condition of a flower having many stamens.

examples.text: The flower exhibits <w>polyandry</w>, which is a common characteristic of this specific plant family.
Botanists classify the specimen based on its <w>polyandry</w> and petal arrangement.
